answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a meadow as the anchor of the cost.
